summary: Barclays PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting routine share disposals by persons discharging managerial responsibilities (PDMRs). The filing discloses two transactions: Craig Bright, Group Co-COO, disposed of 7,000 shares at £4.809 per share, and Taalib Shaah, Group Chief Risk Officer, disposed of 317,011 shares at £4.829 per share, both on 15 June 2026 via the Barclays nominee service administrator. These are standard PDMR share transactions, not a special situation. The filing is a routine current report under UK rules, furnished to the SEC as a Form 6-K. No corporate event, strategic action, or material change is indicated.
